text:
Situation: Alteplase 100 mg vial (NDC 50242-085-27) is listed on the FDA shortage list with a status of To Be Discontinued. The initial posting date for this status is 2026-05-21. Current inventory provides 20 days on hand at Corvale East and 29 days on hand at Corvale General based on current daily use.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the alteplase 100 mg vial status as To Be Discontinued posted 2026-05-21. A Class II recall (D-0509-2024) for Cathflo Activase 2 mg vials was initiated on 2024-05-20 for lack of assurance of sterility due to deformed stoppers observed during filling operations at Genentech, Inc., South San Francisco, CA (FEI 3007232634). FDA inspection 1235654 of FEI 3007232634 ended on 2024-04-19 with a VAI classification and was known to FDA on 2024-06-28.

Our position: Supply is limited and the 100 mg presentation faces discontinuation. The 2 mg presentation was subject to a prior recall. Allocation schedules require verification. No clinical guidance is provided; therapeutic decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy buyers verify allocation schedules with Genentech; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Pharmacy buyers monitor the FDA shortage list for updates on the discontinuation; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Pharmacy buyers assess alternative alteplase presentations or therapeutic alternatives for committee review; requires P&T Committee approval.

Not recommended: No changes to clinical protocols or dosing at this time.
